annotations.title: What federal contract money does this company win, and from which agencies?

description: Use when the user is diligencing a government-services or defense target, sizing recompete risk, or asks how dependent a company is on one agency: "how much does this contractor get from the Army?", "is their federal revenue concentrated?". Returns prime contract obligations by federal fiscal year, the top awarding agencies with their shares, an agency concentration index (HHI) and the recipient names matched, from USAspending.gov. Obligations, not revenue. Refuses before you are charged if nothing is found or the totals do not reconcile. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: built in: by fiscal year (years); segment: awarding agency (in the result). Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For federal spending across a whole topic, use run_spend_trend.
